_comment: Emulator config for the e2e harness ONLY (see e2e/). Kept separate from firebase.json, which is hosting-only and is what deploys the React admin, and from web/firebase.json, which serves the wasm tree on ports 9099/8085. It sits at the package root rather than inside e2e/ because firebase-tools refuses a rules path outside the config's own directory, and pointing at the existing web/firestore.rules mirror is worth more than tidiness: mytribe/firestore.rules keeps that file byte-identical under a test and a pre-commit hook, so the harness runs against the real isAuntie() gate. A third copy of the rules under e2e/ would drift, and a permissive stand-in would make every authenticated spec prove nothing. THE PORTS ARE DELIBERATELY NOT THE DEFAULTS: an e2e run must never silently attach to a dev emulator somebody left running and then report a green earned against their data. NO FUNCTIONS EMULATOR IS DECLARED HERE, AND 5399 IS RESERVED AND UNSERVED. src/lib/firebase.ts pins the Functions SDK at 127.0.0.1:5399 during an e2e run so a callable CANNOT resolve to a deployed us-central1 URL, and nothing listens on it, so an unstubbed callable fails locally and loudly as CallableNotStubbedError instead of quietly leaving the machine. Do not hand 5399 to anything, and do not add a functions block here without reading the measured trade in docs/runbooks/e2e.md first: serving mytribe/functions would register its firestore triggers (onKinfolkCreate, onAuthUserCreate, ...) against e2e/seed.ts's writes and mutate the very rows the specs assert on.
